datasets.name: customer_order_frequency
queryLines:
WITH customer_orders AS (
  SELECT
    user_id,
    MAX(order_number) as total_orders
  FROM
    big_data.gold.order_metrics
  GROUP BY
    user_id
),
order_buckets AS (
  SELECT
    CASE
      WHEN total_orders = 1 THEN '1 order'
      WHEN total_orders BETWEEN 2 AND 5 THEN '2-5 orders'
      WHEN total_orders BETWEEN 6 AND 10 THEN '6-10 orders'
      WHEN total_orders BETWEEN 11 AND 20 THEN '11-20 orders'
      WHEN total_orders BETWEEN 21 AND 50 THEN '21-50 orders'
      ELSE '50+ orders'
    END as order_frequency,
    CASE
      WHEN total_orders = 1 THEN 1
      WHEN total_orders BETWEEN 2 AND 5 THEN 2
      WHEN total_orders BETWEEN 6 AND 10 THEN 3
      WHEN total_orders BETWEEN 11 AND 20 THEN 4
      WHEN total_orders BETWEEN 21 AND 50 THEN 5
      ELSE 6
    END as sort_order,
    COUNT(*) as customer_count
  FROM
    customer_orders
  GROUP BY
    CASE
      WHEN total_orders = 1 THEN '1 order'
      WHEN total_orders BETWEEN 2 AND 5 THEN '2-5 orders'
      WHEN total_orders BETWEEN 6 AND 10 THEN '6-10 orders'
      WHEN total_orders BETWEEN 11 AND 20 THEN '11-20 orders'
      WHEN total_orders BETWEEN 21 AND 50 THEN '21-50 orders'
      ELSE '50+ orders'
    END,
    CASE
      WHEN total_orders = 1 THEN 1
      WHEN total_orders BETWEEN 2 AND 5 THEN 2
      WHEN total_orders BETWEEN 6 AND 10 THEN 3
      WHEN total_orders BETWEEN 11 AND 20 THEN 4
      WHEN total_orders BETWEEN 21 AND 50 THEN 5
      ELSE 6
    END
)
SELECT
  order_frequency,
  customer_count,
  ROUND(customer_count * 100.0 / SUM(customer_count) OVER (), 1) as customer_percentage,
  sort_order
FROM
  order_buckets
ORDER BY
  sort_order

datasets.name: reorder_patterns
queryLines:
WITH product_reorders AS (
  SELECT
    op.product_id,
    om.user_id,
    om.order_id,
    om.days_since_prior_order,
    op.reordered
  FROM
    big_data.silver.order_products op
      INNER JOIN big_data.gold.order_metrics om
        ON op.order_id = om.order_id
  WHERE
    op.reordered = true
    AND om.days_since_prior_order IS NOT NULL
),
product_stats AS (
  SELECT
    pr.product_id,
    COUNT(DISTINCT pr.user_id) as unique_customers,
    COUNT(*) as total_reorders,
    ROUND(AVG(pr.days_since_prior_order), 1) as avg_days_between_reorders,
    ROUND(PERCENTILE(pr.days_since_prior_order, 0.5), 1) as median_days_between_reorders
  FROM
    product_reorders pr
  GROUP BY
    pr.product_id
  HAVING
    COUNT(*) >= 100
)
SELECT
  pe.product_name,
  pe.department,
  pa.reorder_rate,
  ps.avg_days_between_reorders,
  ps.median_days_between_reorders,
  ps.total_reorders,
  ps.unique_customers
FROM
  product_stats ps
    INNER JOIN big_data.silver.products_enriched pe
      ON ps.product_id = pe.product_id
    INNER JOIN big_data.gold.product_abc_analysis pa
      ON ps.product_id = pa.product_id
WHERE
  pa.reorder_rate >= 70
ORDER BY
  ps.total_reorders DESC
LIMIT 20

datasets.name: reorder_value_patterns
queryLines:
WITH product_reorders AS (
  SELECT
    op.product_id,
    om.user_id,
    om.order_id,
    om.days_since_prior_order,
    op.add_to_cart_order as quantity_in_order,
    op.reordered
  FROM
    big_data.silver.order_products op
      INNER JOIN big_data.gold.order_metrics om
        ON op.order_id = om.order_id
  WHERE
    op.reordered = true
    AND om.days_since_prior_order IS NOT NULL
),
product_stats AS (
  SELECT
    pr.product_id,
    COUNT(*) as total_reorders,
    ROUND(AVG(pr.days_since_prior_order), 1) as avg_days_between_reorders,
    ROUND(AVG(pr.quantity_in_order), 1) as avg_quantity_per_reorder
  FROM
    product_reorders pr
  GROUP BY
    pr.product_id
  HAVING
    COUNT(*) >= 1000
)
SELECT
  pe.product_name,
  pe.department,
  pe.price_usd,
  pa.reorder_rate,
  ps.avg_days_between_reorders,
  ps.avg_quantity_per_reorder,
  ROUND(ps.avg_quantity_per_reorder * pe.price_usd, 2) as avg_spend_per_reorder,
  ps.total_reorders
FROM
  product_stats ps
    INNER JOIN big_data.silver.products_enriched pe
      ON ps.product_id = pe.product_id
    INNER JOIN big_data.gold.product_abc_analysis pa
      ON ps.product_id = pa.product_id
WHERE
  pa.reorder_rate >= 70
ORDER BY
  ps.total_reorders DESC
LIMIT 20

datasets.displayName: Top Products by Day of Week
queryLines:
WITH product_by_dow AS (
  SELECT
    CASE om.order_dow
      WHEN 0 THEN 'Sunday'
      WHEN 1 THEN 'Monday'
      WHEN 2 THEN 'Tuesday'
      WHEN 3 THEN 'Wednesday'
      WHEN 4 THEN 'Thursday'
      WHEN 5 THEN 'Friday'
      WHEN 6 THEN 'Saturday'
    END as day_name,
    om.order_dow,
    pe.product_name,
    COUNT(*) as order_count,
    SUM(op.add_to_cart_order) as total_quantity,
    ROUND(SUM(pe.price_usd * op.add_to_cart_order), 2) as total_revenue
  FROM
    big_data.silver.order_products op
      INNER JOIN big_data.gold.order_metrics om
        ON op.order_id = om.order_id
      INNER JOIN big_data.silver.products_enriched pe
        ON op.product_id = pe.product_id
  GROUP BY
    om.order_dow,
    pe.product_name
),
ranked_products AS (
  SELECT
    day_name,
    order_dow,
    product_name,
    order_count,
    total_quantity,
    total_revenue,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY order_dow ORDER BY order_count ASC) as rank
  FROM
    product_by_dow
)
SELECT
  day_name,
  product_name,
  order_count,
  total_quantity,
  total_revenue,
  rank
FROM
  ranked_products
WHERE
  rank <= 5
ORDER BY
  order_dow,
  rank

datasets.name: top_product_pairs
queryLines:
WITH product_pairs AS (
  SELECT
    op1.product_id as product_a_id,
    op2.product_id as product_b_id,
    COUNT(DISTINCT op1.order_id) as pair_frequency
  FROM
    big_data.silver.order_products op1
      INNER JOIN big_data.silver.order_products op2
        ON op1.order_id = op2.order_id
        AND op1.product_id < op2.product_id
  GROUP BY
    op1.product_id,
    op2.product_id
  HAVING
    COUNT(DISTINCT op1.order_id) >= 1000
)
SELECT
  p1.product_name as product_a,
  p2.product_name as product_b,
  pp.pair_frequency,
  ROUND(pp.pair_frequency * (p1.price_usd + p2.price_usd), 0) as estimated_pair_revenue
FROM
  product_pairs pp
    INNER JOIN big_data.silver.products_enriched p1
      ON pp.product_a_id = p1.product_id
    INNER JOIN big_data.silver.products_enriched p2
      ON pp.product_b_id = p2.product_id
ORDER BY
  pp.pair_frequency DESC
LIMIT 30

lines: ## 🤖 ML INSIGHTS & PREDICTIONS
**Objective:** Apply machine learning to predict customer reorders, segment behavior, and revenue opportunities.

### Predictive Analytics Framework

**Model Stack:**
* **Product Reorder Predictor:** XGBoost classifier on product features (reorder_rate, price, department) → predict next-order likelihood
* **Customer Segmentation:** K-Means on RFM features (Recency, Frequency, Monetary) → identify high-value clusters
* **Revenue Forecast:** Prophet time-series model on daily revenue → 30-day outlook

**Training Data:** 32M+ orders, 50K products, 200K customers from big_data.gold
